target_customer: AI teams and GPU owners and operators needing training, inference and agent compute
problem: GPU capacity is prepaid and idle much of the time while teams struggle to get compute; company cites 5 percent average utilization.
business_model: Usage-based GPU compute plus credits for lent idle capacity and reserved clusters
product_category: AI infrastructure, GPU orchestration and marketplace

competitors.name: Shadeform Spot
competitors.what: Marketplace for providers to resell idle GPUs

competitors.name: FriendliAI InferenceSense
competitors.what: Fills idle GPU capacity with inference

competitors.name: Mithril
competitors.what: Relists paused reserved GPU capacity on spot

technical_complexity.rationale: Multi-tenant GPU scheduling, fast cold starts and checkpoint resume are hard systems work; company claims 7.66x faster cold start (self reported).

defensibility.rationale: Many entrants in idle GPU sharing; liquidity could create network effects only at scale.

market_need_then: 2026 coverage shows rapid GPU demand and many products to monetize idle capacity; company cites over $500B in AI infrastructure debt financing.

identity.voice_and_tone: Terse, technical, efficiency focused: 'Squeeze every bit of AI from your infrastructure'

brand_strength.rationale: Name shares with several unrelated Nodus entities and a trademark owner in computing from 2008; no community evidence.

outcome_analysis: Nodus Compute is a Fall 2026 YC company of two ex big tech and Scale AI engineers. It claims over 200 teams joined since launch in October. Idle GPU sharing is crowded with funded entrants, and no funding or exit was found, so outcome factors remain empty.
notes: Name meaning (Latin knot) is general knowledge, not from a source, so name_origin states it as not stated by the company; consider null. Founder education not found. Customer logos on site are not confirmed relationships. 200 teams claim is company stated.
